upload_contract.start: Upload as START frame; exact first-frame anchor.
upload_contract.key: Upload as KEY frame; peak beat reference.
upload_contract.end: Upload as END frame; final-frame target.

reject_focus: Keep monitor_required. Run prompt-against-frame QA and a 3-second motion probe. Reject if Byleth becomes male/ambiguous/war-phase, Thunderbrand becomes a polearm, Catherine becomes a superhero pose, lightning becomes a beam or full-frame effect, Byleth and Ashe freeze as a background pair, the trio forms a horizontal row, any named character enters early, or Chinese/Mandarin/subtitles/UI/borders appear.
promotion_rule: Do not promote to approved_for_video from this package alone. A human or separate reviewer must inspect the generated 3-second clip and record motion_review_passed before full-duration generation.
